rule: present only when the evidence is in the publication, its supplement or a linked repository and a location is recorded; partial when a component is missing; not_applicable only where the definition says so

E01.name: metrics_named
E01.definition: Screening performance metrics are named (sensitivity or recall, specificity, precision, accuracy, F1, workload saved).

E02.name: benchmark_dataset_identified
E02.definition: The evaluation dataset is identified: which review(s), how many records, how many included by the human reference.

E03.name: prevalence_reported
E03.definition: Inclusion prevalence (included records over total) is reported or directly derivable from reported counts.

E04.name: workflow_level_metric
E04.definition: At least one end-to-end workflow metric is reported: time saved, workload reduction, cost, or recall after the human step, not only per-record model metrics.

E05.name: role_statement
E05.definition: The intended role of the model is stated (sole screener, second reviewer, triage or pre-screen) together with what remains a human decision.

E06.name: disagreement_handling
E06.definition: How model versus human disagreements, overrides or escalations are handled in the proposed workflow is stated.

E07.name: affected_groups_or_equity
E07.definition: The study names populations, languages, settings or study types at risk of differential exclusion, or states an equity goal for screening.

E08a.name: subgroup_check_designed
E08a.definition: The evaluation design includes a planned check of performance by subgroup, language, setting or study type.

E08b.name: subgroup_results_reported
E08b.definition: Performance or error rates are reported disaggregated by at least one subgroup (topic, study type, population, language, source).

E08c.name: language_region_results
E08c.definition: Performance is measured across records in different languages or from different regions or settings.

E09.name: acceptable_error_defined
E09.definition: An acceptable error or target threshold (for example minimum sensitivity) is stated together with who set it or the norm it follows.

E10.name: user_perspective_evidence
E10.definition: Reviewer, user or professional perspectives are collected as evidence (survey, interview, usability or workload assessment).

E11.name: failure_modes_identified
E11.definition: Critical failure modes are named (missed eligible studies, hallucinated eligibility reasoning, over-confident exclusion, inconsistency across runs).

E12.name: interaction_failure_checks
E12.definition: Over-reliance, automation bias or alert fatigue in the human and model workflow is addressed in the design or discussed with a mitigation.

E13.name: intended_use_scope
E13.definition: Intended use and non-intended use or scope limits of the screening approach are stated.

E14.name: code_or_workflow_published
E14.definition: Code, prompts or the workflow are published in a repository or supplement with a stable reference (URL, DOI, commit or version).

E15.name: model_prior_evidence
E15.definition: A rationale or prior evidence for the choice of model is given.

E16.name: ground_truth_provenance
E16.definition: The reference standard is defined (for example dual independent human screening or final review inclusion) and its provenance stated.

E17.name: config_reported
E17.definition: Decoding or constraint parameters are reported (temperature, top_p, max tokens, seed, structured output).

E18.name: prompt_text_published
E18.definition: The verbatim prompt or prompts are available in the paper, supplement or repository.

E19.name: prompt_reinforces_human_authority
E19.definition: The prompt includes an uncertainty, unsure or escalation option, or instructs deference to human review. Not applicable when E18 is absent.

E20.name: eligibility_criteria_stated
E20.definition: The eligibility criteria supplied to the model are the review's own criteria and are stated or reproduced.

E21.name: recall_prioritised
E21.definition: The configuration, threshold or decision rule explicitly prioritises sensitivity or recall over precision.

E22.name: leakage_contamination_addressed
E22.definition: Data leakage or training contamination is discussed (model knowledge cutoff versus review date, memorisation of included studies) with a mitigation or an explicit limitation.

E23.name: known_failure_modes_tested
E23.definition: Known LLM failure modes (hallucination, prompt injection, specious plausibility, misuse) are documented and at least one is tested.

E24.name: prompt_robustness_tested
E24.definition: Prompt robustness is tested: prompt variants, wording sensitivity, or repeat-run consistency.

E25.name: data_provenance_documented
E25.definition: Dataset source, collection method and limitations are documented (a data card equivalent).

E26.name: model_card_referenced
E26.definition: A model card, system card or equivalent documentation for the chosen model is cited, or model transparency is explicitly considered in model choice.

E27.name: model_version_pinned
E27.definition: An exact model version identifier and the access or run date are reported.

E28.name: realistic_conditions
E28.definition: The evaluation uses the complete record set of a real review (not a curated or balanced subset) under the access route intended for practice.

E29.name: error_analysis
E29.definition: A systematic error analysis of misclassifications is reported (quantitative or qualitative).

E30.name: test_environment_described
E30.definition: The test environment is described (API or user interface, batching, integration with screening software).

E31.name: limitations_and_failure_modes_documented
E31.definition: A limitations section documents failure modes and uncertainties.

E32.name: worst_case_analysis
E32.definition: Missed eligible studies are characterised (which studies, why) or tail and worst-case performance is reported, not only averages.

E33.name: decision_rule_prespecified
E33.definition: A pre-specified decision rule links metrics to a go, no-go or limited-deployment decision.

E34.name: confidence_intervals
E34.definition: Confidence intervals or another uncertainty measure are reported for headline metrics.

E35.name: energy_cost_reported
E35.definition: Energy, compute or environmental cost is measured and disclosed.
